requirements.title: operator console renders the readiness scoreboard, focus list, gaps registry, and trends
requirements.description: A React/Vite operator console renders per-projection coverage with denominator-confidence, the ranked focus list, the gaps registry, and the trials/convergence trends, following the vrooli-default design contract.

validation.notes: UI: feature components render scoreboard/focus/gaps; target ui/src/features.
E2E: dashboard renders against live aggregator.
